findings.title: Completed work-index disposition does not imply inactive source scope
findings.statement: A completed work-index execution_state can coexist with an active bounded source campaign or registry scope.
falsification_conditions: A governed status model proves that completed work-index disposition and inactive source scope are identical for all campaign and debt objects.
The cited source campaigns are reclassified as inactive historical records without bounded live scope.
findings.recommended_next_action: Encode the distinction in analysis reporting guidance so current-state summaries stop conflating disposition and source activity.
